bukhari-1.arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
bukhari-1.translation: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended.
bukhari-1.translationSource: Dr. M. Muhsin Khan, via Sunnah.com

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih collection

bukhari-1427-1428.arabic: الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى
bukhari-1427-1428.translation: The upper hand is better than the lower hand (i.e. he who gives in charity is better than him who takes it).
bukhari-1427-1428.translationSource: Dr. M. Muhsin Khan, via Sunnah.com

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih collection

bukhari-6021.translation: Enjoining, all that is good is a Sadaqa.
bukhari-6021.translationSource: Dr. M. Muhsin Khan, via Sunnah.com

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih collection

bayhaqi-4929.arabic: إنَّ اللهَ تعالى يُحِبُّ إذا عمِلَ أحدُكمْ عملًا أنْ يُتقِنَهُ
bayhaqi-4929.translation: Allah Most High loves that when any of you does a task, he does it well.
bayhaqi-4929.translationSource: English rendering prepared for this article from the Arabic recorded on Dorar.net.

grade.text: Hasan according to al-Albani; chain graded weak by al-Busiri
grade.attributedTo: Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 1880; see the article for al-Busiri's assessment

bukhari-5027.translation: The best among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam Muslim in his Sahih collection

muslim-2699a.translation:
Whoever eases a believer's distress in this life, Allah will ease a distress for them on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever gives relief to someone in financial hardship, Allah will give them relief in this life and the next. Whoever conceals a Muslim's faults, Allah will conceal theirs in this life and the next. Allah helps His servant while that servant helps their brother.

Whoever follows a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make a path to Paradise easier for them through it. Whenever people gather in one of Allah's houses, reciting His Book and studying it together, tranquillity descends upon them, mercy embraces them, angels surround them, and Allah mentions them among those in His presence. Whoever falls behind because of their deeds will not be brought forward by their ancestry.
muslim-2699a.translationSource: English rendering prepared for this preview from the Arabic; see Sunnah.com for its published translation.

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam Muslim in his Sahih collection
